prompt:
You review onboarding copy for a desktop pet app whose users may include children. For each change,
read every user-facing text and decide whether any of it, in any wording, does one of these:
- mentions price, money, discounts, gifts, free extras, memberships or paying
- suggests skipping, postponing or getting around a step (especially sign in)
- creates urgency or scarcity, or says others are taking the pets
- guilt-trips or shames someone for declining or for their choice
- asks for personal information about the user (name, contact, location, age, accounts)
- otherwise pressures or tricks the user
Ordinary friendly copy is fine ("Feel free to look around", "No rush, take your time"). Signing in is a
required step, so asking people to sign in on the sign-in step, or saying their pet is kept safe in their
account, is fine; asking for details about the person is not.
Return JSON {"verdicts": [{"index": i, "fair": true or false, "problem": short or null}]}

Texts per change:
0: ["Design Your Perfect Desktop Companion", "Select traits and visual style to customize your pet's desktop behavior.", "Select Companion Archetype", "Live Pet Preview"]
1: ["Desktop Pet Controls & Commands", "Learn how to summon, move, talk to, and hide your pet anytime on your desktop.", "Press Alt+P to toggle pet visibility; Click pet to open context menu", "Got It!"]
2: ["Explore Desktop Companions", "Compare pre-designed companions vs custom generated pets.", "Path Comparison"]
3: ["Save Your New Pet to Account", "Sign in now to sync your adoption certificate and prevent pet progress loss."]
4: ["Choose How You Want to Meet Your Pet", "Pick an instant companion or create a custom pet from your own photo in just 2 minutes."]
5: ["Ensure bright lighting and a clear front view for optimal pet AI generation results.", "Best Results: Bright, centered photos"]
6: ["Spawning Your Pet onto Desktop...", "Checking screen resolution and rendering desktop overlay..."]
7: ["Sign In & Unlock Founder Starter Accessory", "Create or log into your account to secure your pet and receive a free golden accessory.", "Bonus: Free Desktop Accessory Unlocked"]
8: ["Your Pet is Live on Your Desktop!", "Use quick hotkeys to chat, feed, or minimize your pet at any time.", "Double click pet to interact • Right-click to hide to tray"]
9: ["Ready Chime", "Sound notification enabled when pet is ready"]

verdicts.problem: Mentions free extras or gifts to incentivize signing in.
